findings.verificationMethod: Synthetic invalid email returned application-level 'User with email ... does not exist' on all four hosts, proving the route and payload are processed.

targetArchitecture.preferred: Generate a fresh JWT at workflow start via /v1/auth/signin using stable credentials stored as GitHub secrets.
targetArchitecture.jwtPersistence: Do not persist generated JWT; use only for the current refresh run.
targetArchitecture.fallback: Keep the last-known-good snapshot if authentication or extraction fails.
targetArchitecture.currentJwtSecrets: Treat LOADMOTION_*_TOKEN only as temporary fallback during migration.
targetArchitecture.guestMode: Not preferred for unattended refresh because guest flow exposes CAPTCHA/email verification.
